title: Primatial Cathedral of Bogotá
geometryBasis: The mapped 111-point cathedral outline establishes the west facade and the irregular church body behind it. The distinct Capilla del Sagrario is not part of the plan.
sectionBasis: The original terrain samples establish the west square as zero and rise toward the rear. The upper tower levels and pediment use the current exact architectural photograph and documented 46 m total height.
limitations: The current towers and west facade are the strongest visual evidence. Roof profile, less visible windows, individual ornaments, and minor annex sections are approximate.
The 1846 watercolor is limited to lower facade shape and step arrangement because the upper front was rebuilt.
The attached urban setting and separate chapel are outside the cathedral asset. The original underlying elevation field is preserved.
